title: Lime Green Account: Interest and APY Explained
summary: The document explains Lime Green Account interest: the account earns 1.5% APY with daily compounding. It covers how daily compounding accrues interest based on the daily balance, how to maximize interest by keeping funds consistently deposited, and where to track earnings in account activity and statements.
